Seasonal adjustment report

Source: R/sa_report.R
sa_report.Rd

sa_report() gathers, for one or several seasonal adjustment models, the description of the pre-processing (sa_preprocessing()), of the decomposition (sa_decomposition()), the diagnostics (sa_diagnostics()) and some plots. In a Quarto (or R Markdown) document, the result is automatically rendered whatever the output format. render_report() directly renders a report in a file using a Quarto template (see report_template()).

sa_report(
  x,
  preprocessing = TRUE,
  decomposition = TRUE,
  diagnostics = TRUE,
  plots = TRUE,
  title_level = 2,
  ...
)

render_report(
  x,
  output_file,
  output_format = c("html", "pdf", "typst", "docx"),
  title = "Seasonal adjustment report",
  template = report_template(),
  preprocessing = TRUE,
  decomposition = TRUE,
  diagnostics = TRUE,
  plots = TRUE,
  title_level = 1,
  quiet = TRUE,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

the model(s) to describe. It can be:

  • a seasonal adjustment model (see sa_preprocessing() for the supported objects);

  • a (named) list of seasonal adjustment models;

  • a workspace: the path to the workspace file (.xml), a Java workspace opened with rjd3workspace::jws_open() or a workspace read with rjd3workspace::read_workspace().

preprocessing, decomposition, diagnostics

booleans indicating which parts should be printed.

plots

boolean indicating if the plots (series and SI-ratios) should be printed.

title_level

level of the first headings. For a workspace, the multiprocessings are printed with headings of level title_level and the SA-items with headings of level title_level + 1. For a list of models, the models are printed with headings of level title_level. For a single model, the parts of the report (pre-processing, decomposition, diagnostics) are printed with headings of level title_level.

...

other parameters passed to sa_preprocessing(), sa_decomposition() and sa_diagnostics() (e.g.: digits or decimal.mark).

output_file

the output file (e.g. "report.html", "report.pdf" or "report.docx").

output_format

the Quarto output format: "html" (default), "pdf" (PDF with LaTeX), "typst" (PDF with Typst) or "docx". See quarto::quarto_render().

title

the title of the report.

template

the Quarto template used to render the report (see report_template()).

quiet

boolean indicating if the output of Quarto should be suppressed.

Value

sa_report() returns an object of class "rjd3report_block" (see print.rjd3report_block()).

render_report() returns invisibly the path of the output file.

Examples

y <- rjd3toolkit::ABS$X0.2.09.10.M
sa_x13 <- rjd3x13::x13(y)
sa_ts <- rjd3tramoseats::tramoseats(y)
# In a Quarto document:
# sa_report(sa_x13)
# sa_report(list(X13 = sa_x13, `TRAMO-SEATS` = sa_ts))

# \donttest{
if (quarto::quarto_available()) {
  output_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".html")
  render_report(list(X13 = sa_x13, `TRAMO-SEATS` = sa_ts), output_file)
  # browseURL(output_file)

  # From a workspace
  ws <- system.file("workspaces", "workspace_test.xml", package = "rjd3workspace")
  output_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".pdf")
  render_report(ws, output_file, output_format = "typst")
}
# }
